messages:
deploybot: Deploy request received: hotfix/service-tokenizer v2026.03.21-rc2 -> production. Change window: midnight->01:30 UTC. Canaries: 2/4. Auto-rollback: enabled.

jess (eng-oncall): tagging for expedited approval — this is the memory leak fix hitting eu-west1 under high-concurrency.

sam (eng-release): quick summary: regression from recent KV-cache change. Fix reverts a small allocator tweak, no schema changes. Patch tested on staging + perf run.

maya (product): impact: search embeddings failing ~3% of requests in EU (timeouts). Customers noticing. Need minimal blast radius.

luke (sre): want to pin image digest and skip staged traffic cut if we can keep latency stable. Also need rollout plan + rollback criteria.

ana (typo) ana (eng-lead): typo — i'm ana. Approving expedited path if we keep canary and have clear rollback triggers.

sam (eng-release): Proposed rollout:
- deploy 2 canary hosts (canary=2/4)
- monitor p95 latency, error-rate, kv miss-rate for 10m
- if p95 increases >15% or errors >1%, rollback automatically

jess (eng-oncall): I can watch telemetry and give +1 after initial canaries if green.

deploybot: To expedite, run `/deploy fasttrack hotfix/service-tokenizer@sha256:abc123 --canaries 2 --skip-manual-hold`

luke (sre): Do NOT skip manual hold. We need at least one human ack on metrics before full rollout. Auto-rollback ok.

sam (eng-release): updated command then: `/deploy fasttrack hotfix/service-tokenizer@sha256:abc123 --canaries 2`

maya (product): also add release note line for ops: "hotfix: revert allocator tweak to address tokenizer memory leak in high-concurrency EU workloads"

ana ana (eng-lead): I'm +1 for canary deploy. Jess will ack after 10m if green. Sam please ensure image pin and helm values include `max_concurrency: 250` fallback.

jess (eng-oncall): Starting canary now. Watching p95, 5xx, and mem-usage. Will post results in 10m.

deploybot: Canary rollout started: hosts 02/04 -> hotfix/service-tokenizer@sha256:abc123.

jess (eng-oncall): 10m check: p95 -1%, 5xx 0.0%, mem usage down ~12% on canaries. Green.

luke (sre): Observability: traces look clean, no new error signatures. Cool.

ana ana (eng-lead): Ok proceed to full rollout over 15m. Sam, please kick.

sam (eng-release): Kicking full rollout now. Command: `/deploy promote hotfix/service-tokenizer@sha256:abc123 --rollout 15m`

deploybot: Full rollout initiated. Progress: 10% -> 35% -> 70% -> 100%.

jess (eng-oncall): Monitoring steady. No regressions in EU.

maya (product): Notifying CS with release note: "Hotfix deployed: tokenizer memory leak mitigated for EU high-concurrency customers."

luke (sre): Post-deploy checklist: drain old nodes, confirm no residual high-mem pods, update incident dashboard.

sam (eng-release): All done. Closing thread. Thanks all. :tada:
